{{Quote|General Kenobi's battalions have routed the last holdouts of Umbarans, and we've secured all sectors. We did it. We took Umbara.|[[Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Fives]] reports the Republic's reclamation of Umbara|<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>}}
The '''occupation of Umbara''' began in [[20 BBY]] as an effort by the [[Galactic Republic]] to control the newly-reclaimed [[Expansion Region]] [[planet]] [[Umbara]]. Having just secured control over the world in the bloodily [[Battle of Umbara]], the Republic's occupation served to enforce its authority over the world, although it was opposed by the [[Umbaran Partisans]]. The occupation was then continued by the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire]].

==Prelude==
[[Umbara]] was a [[planet]] in the [[Expansion Region]] of [[the galaxy]] that was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Umbaran]] people. Umbara was a member of the [[Galactic Republic]] since the [[Galaxy|galactic]] government's founding. As such, the Umbarans enjoyed representation in the Republic, but they also showcased a habit of prioritizing their homeworld over the rest of the Republic. Enjoying a long tradition of galactic politics but often considered mysterious or deceitful, the Umbarans, thus, endured a contentious history with the government. In Umbaran political culture, changing one's position was not a betrayal but simply a way of working to better their status.<ref name="RiseSeps">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]''</ref>

[[File:UmbaranCrawlerTank-BattleOfUmbara.png|thumb|left|300px|The Battle of Umbara saw brutal conflict between the native Umbara Militia and clone troopers of the Republic Army.]]
During the [[Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the secessionist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Umbara remained a member of the Republic and was represented by [[Senator]] [[Mee Deechi]]. After Deechi's murder, however, the Umbarans would decide to secede to the Confederacy,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> providing the Republic's rival government with their advanced technology<ref name="Battles Changed Galaxy">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> and securing the CIS with a greater control over isolated, yet vital, [[Hyperspace route|supply routes]] in the Expansion Region.<ref name="Darkness">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref> Further, the planet was home to a supply of [[doonium]]. Overall, Umbara became a Confederate stronghold.<ref name="Thrawn">[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']]</ref> However, the bloody [[Battle of Umbara]], in which the native [[Umbaran Militia]] fought for the CIS,<ref name="Carnage of Krell" /> resulted in the Republic reclaiming Umbara<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and instituting an occupation.<ref name="Luco" />

==The occupation==
The Republic's occupation was opposed by the [[Umbaran Partisans]], a resistance and [[terrorist]] network led by the Umbaran [[Rhy Cesca]]. Cesca became notorious as the leader of the partisans and maintained contact with the greater Confederacy, including with the [[Executive Separatist Council]] and [[Infinite Coil]] paramilitary faction.<ref name="SWZC" />

The Republic's occupation of Umbara, much like its initial invasion, was an upsetting affair for the Umbaran [[sniper]] [[Luco Bronc]], himself a veteran of the Battle of Umbara<ref name="Luco" /> and Cesca's lover.<ref name="SWZC" /> All the same, he managed to escape the occupation<ref name="Luco" /> as a result of becoming a Republic prisoner.<ref name="SWZC" /> Around [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{ZeroCompanyDate}}</ref> Bronc found himself [[Hunt for Kundri Fathom|working]] as part of [[Zero Company]]<ref name="Luco" /> and fighting against the CIS.<ref name="SWZC" />

At the [[Mission to Mustafar|end of the war]] in [[19 BBY]], the Republic was [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire]] by [[Supreme Chancellor]]-turned-[[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> The Empire inherited and maintained the occupation.<ref name="SWZC" /> A [[rebellion on Umbara]] was launched against the Empire early in its [[Imperial Era|reign]],<ref name="Catalyst">''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''</ref> but the Empire was ultimately able to establish its authority over the planet.<ref name="Thrawn">[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']]</ref> Following this, Rex, the leader of the Clone Underground, contacted Zero Company offering them payment to [[Ambush on Baker's squad|rescue]] the [[Clone commando]] [[Baker]], who had defected to the underground, from imperial forces. Zero Company was then contacted again by Rex, offering an increased payment to [[Attack on an imperial black site|attack]] an imperial black site, which he had found using Bronc's contacts. This led to the discovery of [[Project Blackstaff]], and the execution of the [[Cloning|clone]] [[science officer]] [[CT-4646]] by [[Trick]].<ref name="SWZC" />
